verdicts.reason: A's headline is big and fills the canvas well, but it sits tight to the top edge and breaks into 4 lines, leaving 'Bubbles,' alone on the first line. The bottom row, with the left-aligned subtitle and the CTA, doesn't line up with the centred headline, and the subtitle is very small. B's smaller headline leaves 'a' dangling at the end of a line and creates a dead gap above the bottom row. B's subtitle also nearly touches the CTA button, so the bottom row looks cramped and the layout feels less intentional than A.
